outcome: frequency of regulatory B cells (Breg cells)
levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines in maternal serum
secretion of pro-inflammatory cytokine IL-6 by maternal B cells
cohort: The study included women undergoing preterm birth and control women, with peripheral blood samples taken immediately before giving birth via cesarean section.
finding: Women delivering preterm exhibited a reduced number of Breg cells and decreased IL-10-producing B cells, along with increased levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines in maternal serum and higher IL-6 secretion from isolated B cells, compared to control women.
cross-section timing: Immediately before giving birth via cesarean section
gest_age: Preterm birth was defined as birth before 37 completed weeks of gestation.
